description: This Java interface defines a ConnectionLogger used for logging events related to connections within the system, such as successful connections, failures, and exceptions. It provides methods for retrieving logs and logging various event types, often with additional contextual information.

classes.name: ConnectionLogger
classes.description: Interface for logging connection events, providing methods to log successes, failures, exceptions, retrieve logs, and clear logs.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Static factory method to obtain a ConnectionLogger instance for a specific connection ID based on the provided configuration.

methods.name: getLogs
methods.description: Retrieve all log entries stored in this logger.

methods.name: success
methods.description: Log a success event, with optional custom message and message arguments.

methods.name: failure
methods.description: Log a failure event, with overloads for including an exception, custom message, or just the info provider.

methods.name: exception
methods.description: Log an exception event, with overloads for including a message or exception object.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clear all logs stored in this logger.

methods.name: default success
methods.description: Convenience method to log success with a message and arguments, using an empty info provider.

methods.name: default failure with message
methods.description: Convenience method to log failure with a message and arguments, using an empty info provider.

methods.name: default failure with info provider
methods.description: Convenience method to log failure with only an info provider.

methods.name: failure with Signal
methods.description: Logs a failure related to a specific Signal object, using its context for info.

methods.name: exception with message
methods.description: Logs an exception event with a custom message and arguments.

methods.name: exception with info provider
methods.description: Logs an exception event using an infoprovider, without specifying an exception object.
